brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Palestinian journalists, including Amar and Hassan, continue documenting Israel's operations in Gaza despite severe hardship. The journalists operate without adequate protective equipment or working tools, facing displacement and food insecurity as they attempt to cover the conflict.

The journalists have persisted in documenting casualties from what the report characterizes as a three-year genocide in Gaza, despite restrictions imposed by Israeli occupation authorities.

title: Palestinian journalists Amar and Hassan face persecution and displacement
